edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar (collectively, the “Parties”) wish to resolve the claims between them on the terms set forth in this Agreement.
edits.name: Clean recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total sum of [Settlement Amount] (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date and receipt of completed payment instructions and any reasonably required tax forms.
edits.name: Payment terms

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and each of their respective past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and attorneys, irrevocably releases and forever discharges Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, predecessors, successors, assigns, and each of their respective past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, and attorneys from all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, and damages, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the facts and claims asserted or that could have been asserted in the action through the Effective Date. Plaintiff shall not commence or maintain any action based on a released claim. Nothing in this Agreement releases obligations created by this Agreement.
edits.name: Comprehensive release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Parties shall keep the amount and terms of this settlement confidential and shall not disclose them to any person, except to their attorneys, accountants, tax advisers, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who have a need to know and are bound by confidentiality obligations, or as required by law, regulation, court order, or to enforce this Agreement. A Party required to disclose shall, to the extent legally permitted, provide the other Party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking protective treatment. Nothing in this section prevents either Party from making truthful statements about the underlying events or responding truthfully to legal process.
edits.name: Confidentiality with customary exceptions

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment made under it are a compromise of disputed claims and shall not be construed as an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or the validity of any claim by Defendant. Defendant denies liability.
edits.name: No admission
